Summary: Check if there is a creation of a custom store named "ASE2000 TLS Certificates" when you generate or import a Server/Client certificate into the application.
Preconditions:
1. Open ASE2000 in IEC104.
2. Go to Tools->Properties->IEC104->TLS 1.2->Certificate Management window button.
Actions:
1. Press Windows key + R.
2. Type "certmgr.msc"
3. In the Windows Certificate Store check if there is store folder in the name of ASE2000 TLS Certificates present.

Summary: Added a prompt for duplicate entries into certificate store.
Preconditions:

Summary: Added a prompt for when trying to change the Certificate name to a name which is already present in the certificate store.
Preconditions:
1. Open ASE2000 in IEC104.
2. Go to Tools->Properties->IEC104->TLS 1.2->Certificate Management window button.
Actions:
1. Create/Import any certificate in any tab.
2. Now change its name to any custom name you desire.
3. Create/Import another certificate.
4. Now try to change its name to the same custom name you earlier inputted for the previous certificate.
5. Verify that you are greeted with a prompt stating "Entered name is already present in the certificate store! Try another name."
6. And also that the entered name will be reverted back to its original value before edit.
Expected Results:
Verify that you prompted with a Message box stating "Entered name is already present in the certificate store! Try another name." when you try to change the name of a certificate to a name of a certificate which is already present in the certificate store under this name.
Also verify that the certificate name will be reverted back to the original value before edit.

Summary: To check if the RTU sends an Authentication Error after an Unsolicited Response when Confirm is selected as Critical, and Aggressive Mode is disabled.
Preconditions:
Have two instances of ASE 2000 – Master and RTU,
Running and connected in Task Mode with the following configuration:
Protocol: DNP3 LAN/WAN
Points: Binary Input / Analog Input points
Property Configuration:
On the Master and RTU Instances:
1. Tools -> Properties -> DNP3 LAN/WAN -> Secure Auth. V5
2. Enable Secure Authentication V5
3. Select any Key Change Method, any (net) MAC Algorithm, any Key Wrap Algorithm. If Symmetric/Asymmetric methods chosen, do the further required configurations. Make sure both instances have the same configuration.
4. Opt. Critical Functions -> Select ‘Confirm’
On the Master Instance:
1. Tools -> Properties -> DNP3 LAN/WAN -> Simulation
2. Check the ‘Disable UDP Listen’
On the RTU Instance:
1. Tools -> Properties -> DNP3 LAN/WAN -> Simulation
2. Check the ‘Enable Unsolicited’
Actions:
1. Send Once: Initialization -> Link Status & Reset Link
2. Send Once: Secure Authentication -> Session Key Change
3. Send Once: Initialization ->Enable Unsolicited Responses
4. On the Master: Point List -> Change the Raw Value of any point
Expected Results: After changing the Raw value of a point on the RTU, a ‘Binary/Analog Input Change Response from RTU’ must be sent from the RTU depending on the point type. On expanding this message in the Messages View, we must have a ‘Binary/Analog Input Change’ group type and a ‘Authentication’ group type. This response from the RTU must not be followed by an ‘Authentication Error Request’ by the RTU.

3. Use Connect button to establish a connection.
Expected Results:
1. Verify that client and server is connected using TLS1.2 and proper handshake take place using Wireshark.
2. Verify tls handshake complete message.

Summary: Confirm IEC104 task mode protocol as Master supports TLS1.3 in connection
Preconditions:
1. Run ASE2000 RTU in task mode using IEC104 protocol with checked TLS1.3 check box and server certificate added to Certificate Mangement list
2. Use Wireshark to capture packets.
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 master in task mode using IEC104 protocol.
2. Configure in loopback IP with port as 443. Check the TLS1.3 checkbox and add the client certificate to be used in the certification management list.
3. Use Connect button to establish a connection.
Expected Results: 1. Verify that master is connecting successfully to the RTU using TLS1.3 using Wireshark

Summary: Confirm IEC104 task mode protocol as Master supports all TLS1.3 ciphers in connection
Preconditions:
1. Run ASE2000 RTU in task mode using IEC104 protocol with checked TLS1.3 check box and server certificate added to Certificate Mangement list
2. The ciphers need to be added to Group Policy settings as they depend on SChannel
3. Use wireshark to capture packets.
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 master in task mode using IEC104 protocol.
2. Configure in loopback IP with port as 443. Check the TLS1.3 checkbox and add the client certificate to be used in the certification management list.
3. Use Connect button to establish a connection.
4. Monitor the supported cipher suits in wireshark
Expected Results:
1. Verify the following cipher suits are supported:
TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256

Summary: Confirm IEC104 task mode protocol as RTU supports TLS1.3 in connection
Preconditions:
1. Enable TLS1.3 must be checked in both Master and RTU
2. Use wireshark to capture packets.
3. Root certificate needed to be added to Windows store

1. Run ASE2000 RTU in task mode using IEC104 protocol with checked TLS1.3 check box and server certificate added to Certificate Mangement list
2. Open another ASE2000 task mode instance as master using IEC104 protocol with checked TLS1.3 check box. Add client certificate in certification management list.
3. Use Connect button to establish a connection.
Expected Results:
1. Verify that RTU is allowing full TLS 1.3 handshake using Wireshark.
2. Confirm secure session is established.

Summary: Try ASE2000 self-signed certificates with Enabled CRL Check for TLS 1.2
Preconditions:
1. Open two instances of ASE2000 in IEC104. (One in RTU mode and one in Master mode)
2. Go to Tools->Properties->IEC104->TLS 1.2
3. Set proper IP and Port number in both instances.
Actions:
1. Enable the Enable CRL Check checkbox.
2. Import/Generate ASE2000 self-signed server certificates in RTU mode.
3. Import/Generate ASE2000 self-signed client certificates in Master mode.
4. Run the RTU.
5. Click on the connect button in Client.
6. Verify that the connection has been established and TLS 1.2 handshake successful message is seen in Line monitor.

Preconditions:

In Exchange Mode for

Summary: IEC 104 T-profile. Master should disconnect after configured response timeout if server is unresponsive.
Actions:
1. Run ASE2000 RTU in task mode using IEC104 protocol without selecting TLS.
2. Open another ASE2000 task mode instance as master using IEC104 protocol with TLS 1.2/1.3 configuration. Import or generate certificates. Set response timeout to 5 seconds.
3. Use Connect button to establish a connection.
Expected Results:
Verify that ASE2000 master is disconnecting properly after configured timeout if server is not responding
"TLS 1.2::Alarm::Unable to read data from the transport connection: A connection attempt failed because the connected party did not properly respond after a period of time, or established connection failed because connected host has failed to respond".
Remarks: In slow or remote networks, the server may take more time to respond. In such scenario, for positive cases, the configured timeout should be increased.

Summary: RSA_PSS_RSAE and RSA_PSS should be under peer supported algorithm and shouldestablish connection
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 RTU in task mode using IEC104 protocol with TLS1.2 configuration
2. Open another ASE2000 task mode instance as master using IEC104 protocol with TLS1.2 configuration.
3. In RTU, Go to Tools->Properties->IEC104->TLS 1.2, in the Signature algorithm combo box select RSA_PKCS1 with any hash algorithm and key length.
4. Generate any Server Certificate with any Root CA certificate in RTU with this signature algorithm
5. In Master, Go to Tools->Properties->IEC104->TLS 1.2, in the Signature algorithm combo box select RSA_PSS with any hash algorithm and key length.
4. Generate any Client Certificate with any Root CA certificate with the selected signature algorithm.
5. Run RTU and then Use Connect button in Master to establish a connection between RTU and Master
Expected Results:
Verify that ASE2000 master is establishing connection with server
Remarks: Since both are RSA connection should be established
